assertions.assertion: States that with server-side sessions the cookie carries only the session id, not tokens
assertions.rationale: It states the cookie holds only an opaque session id and no tokens or claims.

assertions.assertion: States that all tokens, including refresh tokens, are stored server-side in the session store
assertions.rationale: It says the access, ID, and refresh tokens all live in the server-side session store.

assertions.assertion: Explains the in-memory store is lost on process restart and not shared across instances (users appear logged out on a different node)
assertions.rationale: It explains the in-memory store is not durable (lost on restart) and not shared, so a request to a different node appears logged out.

assertions.assertion: Recommends a persistent, shared store for multi-node BFF via Duende.BFF.EntityFramework / AddEntityFrameworkServerSideSessions
assertions.rationale: It recommends Duende.BFF.EntityFramework's AddEntityFrameworkServerSideSessions with SQL Server as the shared store, including code.
